title: Escape Room Loco
specs: Escape rooms have success rates ranging from 27% to 54% depending on room and age
Rooms have kid-friendly clues and some have flashing lights or difficult puzzles
Children 12 and younger require 1 adult in the room with them
Kids clues available for kids 14 and younger
Facility not wheelchair accessible (second story of older building)
Games designed for groups 2-8 people; larger groups allowed with extra charge

blurb: Guests participate in immersive escape room games where they solve puzzles and challenges within 60 minutes. They can also book a portable escape game called The Crate from El Dorado for team building events. All bookings are private and designed for groups between 2 and 8 people, with options for larger groups at extra cost.
